preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (address 0xBd51b6D98574327734C1621A7283778c5e6Af86e)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable all swap and liquidity functionality. This will stop automatic token swaps and liquidity additions, effectively freezing transaction processing for all users except the owner who remains excluded from fees and restrictions.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() that can disable the automatic swap and liquidity functionality. When disabled, the contract won't automatically convert tokens to ETH and add liquidity, which could freeze transaction processing for regular users while the owner remains excluded from fees and restrictions.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the swap and liquidity mechanism.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner address (0xBd51b6D98574327734C1621A7283778c5e6Af86e)
2. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) on the target contract
3. Verify that swapAndLiquifyEnabled is now false
